scoring_justification: Full recompute of RMSE from raw predictions is infeasible without the agent's trained potentials and reference dataset. Checker verifies self-reported errors meet thresholds and improvement over baseline, and compares lattice/exchange values to paper-derived gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold target values for all checks
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper reported mHDNNP results (Table 1, text, equations); reproduced in reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.generation_method: direct transcription of paper's reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values agree with the paper's stated quantities for the mHDNNP potential trained on the same reference method (HSE06) and same system; used to define acceptable tolerances for a reproduction with a different DFT code and smaller training set

units.value: meV/atom for E_RMSE, eV/Å for F_RMSE

outputs.description: Comparison of energy and force RMSE between ACSF‑only HDNNP and mHDNNP on train/test splits. The mHDNNP must exhibit significantly lower errors than the ACSF‑only baseline.
Lattice parameters of AFM‑II (rhombohedral) and FM (cubic) phases optimized with the mHDNNP.
Heisenberg exchange constants J1, J2, mean‑field Néel temperature T_N, and MC‑derived Néel temperature T_N_MC from spin‑flip simulations on a cubic 6×6×6 MnO supercell at 4.430 Å.

output_contract.notes: The RMSE CSV must show mHDNNP errors substantially lower than ACSF‑only; specific thresholds are hidden. Lattice parameters, exchange constants, and both Néel temperatures are compared to the paper’s HSE06 reference values with tolerances appropriate for a different DFT code and training dataset. All quantities are produced by the agent’s own pipeline; no pre‑trained potentials or external datasets are provided.
